This will help you create a good foundation for decorating and make the process more efficient. 2. **Setting up the main decorations**: Focus on putting up the main decorations, such as the rangoli designs, torans (door hangings), and any other large decorative items. This will give you a sense of the overall look and feel of your home. 3. **Preparing the diyas**: Make or buy the diyas and light them up in the evening to get a sense of the ambiance.
